name: Lovely Lovedoll
original_name: ラブリー・ラブドール
source:
A huge box is delivered to main character's house. Insides is a sleeping girl. She is the latest model of love doll. It is protagonist's duty to test the product and help it develop.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个巨大的箱子被送到主人公家中，里面躺着一名沉睡的女孩。她是最新型号的性爱娃娃，主人公负责测试产品并协助她继续成长。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
